caption:
Triple Chocolate Muffins

Ingredients: 
Dry:
-125 grams maida
-20 grams cocoa powder
-1/2 tsp baking soda
-salt, pinch
-100 grams caster sugar

Wet:
-1 egg
-90 grams yogurt 
-60 grams oil
-60 grams milk
-1 tsp vanilla essense

Mix in:
-150 grams chopped chocolate, 50 gms each milk, white and dark
-reduce quantity of chocolate and add nuts of your choice

Methods: 
-Preheat your oven to 200 degrees
-in a large bowl, sift together your maida+cocoa powder+salt+baking soda
-add in your caster sugar
-in another bowl, mix together your wet ingredients
-add your wet ingredients to the dry ones and using a spatula, fold it in gently 
-add in your chocolate last and mix gently (never overmix batters, they could become dense) I add my chocolate with the dry ingredients that way I usually fold the mix in less 
-scoop into your muffin liners and fill all the way to the top. 
-bake for 10 mins @ 200 degrees and reduce the tempreture to 170  for the remaining 10 minutes

How to check they are done
-insert a toothpick in the muffin and if it comes out clean / light crumbs it is ready
( pls note you have added chunks of chocolate in the batter and sometimes it comes on the toothpick. you will understand your muffins are also done when they look cooled and are stable when you jiggle the tray
